blocks.prompt: 15 Find the general solution of the differential equation \((x^2 + 3y^2)\,dx - 2xy\,dy = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
\(x^2\), \(3y^2\) aur \(2xy\): teeno terms ki degree 2 hai, is liye equation homogeneous hai.
Diya kya hai? \((x^2 + 3y^2)\,dx - 2xy\,dy = 0\). Find kya karna hai? General solution.
Rule kaunsa? \(y = vx\) rakhna, kyunke homogeneous equation is se separable ban jati hai.
Is sawal ki khoobsurti yeh hai ke integration ke waqt numerator bilkul denominator ka derivative ban jata hai, is liye seedha log aata hai.
Plan: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) nikalna, \(y = vx\), simplify, variables alag, integrate, \(v\) wapas.
steps:
Diya gaya: \((x^2 + 3y^2)\,dx - 2xy\,dy = 0\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Homogeneous equation: \(y = vx\), \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\).

\(\frac{dy}{dx}\) likhein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{x^2 + 3y^2}{2xy}\]
\[= \dfrac{1 + 3v^2}{2v}\]
Kyun: \(2xy\,dy\) ko doosri taraf le gaye aur \(2xy\,dx\) se divide kiya. Kitab ke Note wala shortcut: homogeneous expression mein \(x\) ki jagah 1 aur \(y\) ki jagah \(v\) rakh dein, seedha \(F(v)\) mil jata hai.

\(y = vx\) rakh kar simplify karein
\[v + x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = \dfrac{1 + 3v^2}{2v}\]
\[x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = \dfrac{1 + 3v^2 - 2v^2}{2v}\]
\[x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = \dfrac{1 + v^2}{2v}\]
Kyun: \(v\) ko right side le gaye. Fractions ko jama ya minus karne ke liye denominator ek jaisa chahiye, is liye \(v = \frac{2v^2}{2v}\) likha. Ab \(3v^2 - 2v^2 = v^2\).
Dhyan dein: Bohat se students yahan \(v\) ko minus karna bhool jate hain aur seedha \(\frac{1 + 3v^2}{2v}\) ko separate kar dete hain; is se jawab ghalat aata hai.

Variables alag karein
\[\dfrac{2v}{1 + v^2}\,dv = \dfrac{dx}{x}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{2v}{1 + v^2}\) ko \(dv\) ke saath aur \(\frac{1}{x}\) ko \(dx\) ke saath rakha; ab dono taraf ek hi variable hai.

Integrate karein
\[\ln(1 + v^2) = \ln|x| + \ln|C|\]
\[1 + v^2 = Cx\]
Kyun: Numerator \(2v\) denominator \(1 + v^2\) ka derivative hai, aur rule hai \(\int \frac{f'(v)}{f(v)}\,dv = \ln|f(v)|\). \(1 + v^2\) hamesha positive hai is liye modulus ki zaroorat nahi. Phir \(\ln|x| + \ln|C| = \ln|Cx|\) kar ke dono taraf se log hata diya.

\(v = y/x\) wapas rakhein
\[1 + \dfrac{y^2}{x^2} = Cx\]
\[x^2 + y^2 = Cx^3\]
Kyun: Fraction khatam karne ke liye dono taraf \(x^2\) se multiply kiya: \(x^2 \cdot 1 = x^2\), \(x^2 \cdot \frac{y^2}{x^2} = y^2\) aur \(Cx \cdot x^2 = Cx^3\).

Tasdeeq
\(x^2 + y^2 = Cx^3\) ko differentiate karein: \(2x + 2yy' = 3Cx^2\). \(C = \frac{x^2 + y^2}{x^3}\) rakhein:
\[2yy' = \dfrac{3(x^2 + y^2)}{x} - 2x\]
\[2xy\,y' = x^2 + 3y^2\]
Yeh wohi di hui equation hai \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Doosri line ko \(x\) se multiply kiya: \(3x^2 + 3y^2 - 2x^2 = x^2 + 3y^2\). Constant khatam karne par asal equation mil gayi, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab number 17 par chhapa hai, 15 par nahi. Exercise 4.2 ki keys 2 se 29 tak hain jabke sawal sirf 25 hain (key 2 Question 1 ka jawab hai, aur keys 15, 19 aur 27 kisi chhape hue sawal ki nahi), is liye jawab 17 par dhoondiye, warna aap kisi aur sawal ka jawab dekh kar pareshan ho jayenge. Jawab khud, \(x^2 + y^2 = Cx^3\), sahi hai.
